english.title: Without permission / lawful authority / excuse enter / leave Gatwick Airport through a gate / exit
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without the permission of Gatwick Airport Limited having first been obtained or lawful authority or excuse,

(A)_[entered]_
(B)_[left]_

Gatwick Airport - London otherwise than through

(C)_[a gate]_
(D)_[an entrance]_
(E)_[an exit]_

for the time being provided by Gatwick Airport Limited for that purpose
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 4(11) and 2(3) of the Gatwick Airport - London Byelaws 1996 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.
